column1: # VERIFIED RESULTS -- Phase A2 full-text verification completed 2026-08-17: 46 of 48 parameters were closed out against the 14 source full texts and 43 carry a table/page locator; 2 remain unresolvable assumptions (the ciNPWT institutional net acquisition price and the superficial tunnel length). SSI/ciNPWT risk-threshold Markov CUA; US commercial payer; 2025 USD; monthly cycles; 24-cycle base horizon; 3%/yr discounting; WTP $100000/QALY.

column18: note

Derived from the base-case per-patient increment (24 cycles, 3%/yr discounting, 2025 USD) scaled by n_treated. 'Risk-targeted ciNPWT' is reported this way -- as a DERIVED result parameterized by the proportion treated -- rather than as a separately modelled third arm, because the population distribution of predicted 90-day SSI risk is unavailable. The two are mathematically identical and this avoids inventing a distribution. inc_cost_total_usd is the budget line (negative = savings); net_budget_impact_100k_usd is the population INMB at $100,000/QALY. The $60 decolonization bundle is background in BOTH arms and cancels, so it is not a ciNPWT budget line.
